remarks: Move right in to this super affordable home in beautiful Brook view condos , 1st floor well maintained 2 bedrooms with fully applianced kitchen w/ Corian counters, separate dining area, large living rm, also bonus screened 3 season room, home has new paint in many rooms, good storage including a deep closet in the main hall of building, coin laundry in basement along with a nice size personal locking storage unit, the affordable HOA fees includes nearly everything except electric and internet/tv, and yes HEAT INCLUDED ! the grounds are gorgeous with a sitting area in the back with benches that leads to beautiful Buffalo creek, this is a peaceful neighborhood with a  convenient location close to stores and rt 400 thruway, very nice in and out !
